name: ds-pubspec
displayName: Pubspec Health — SwiftPM, AGP 9 & Discontinued Packages
description: Flags discontinued and retracted Flutter/Dart packages in pubspec.yaml, and the plugins in your dependency tree that still need CocoaPods (its registry goes read-only on 2 Dec 2026) or block AGP 9's built-in Kotlin. Quick fixes, and hovers with pub points, likes and downloads.

pubspecHealth.enable.description: Check pubspec.yaml files for discontinued, retracted and outdated packages, and plugins that block Swift Package Manager or AGP 9's built-in Kotlin.

enumDescriptions: A dependency its author has discontinued on pub.dev.
The locked version was retracted by its author.
A newer release is out (shown as a faint hint).
A plugin in the dependency tree has no Swift package for the locked version, so it still needs CocoaPods.
A plugin in the dependency tree still applies the Kotlin Gradle Plugin.

pubspecHealth.disabledChecks.markdownDescription: Checks to turn off everywhere. To hush one project only, set this in its `.vscode/settings.json`.

pubspecHealth.cacheHours.description: How long answers from pub.dev are reused before asking again. pub.dev rate-limits bursts, so keep this in hours.
